avis.texte: Pore blackhead dissolver is a great product i love it and will surely purchase again.
I like this Blackhead Dissolver serum, it makes my pores smaller and skin very hydrated.

This is a gem! I noticed softer skin and cleaner, tighter-looking pores after just one use. After a month, my acne-prone skin looks clearer and smoother. Truly next-level pore cleansing. Highly recommend!
I heard so many great things about this product before I purchased this - it's very easy to use and works wonderfully to reduce blackheads around the nose! Highly recommend!
I was very impressed with this product. Very easy to use and it clearly removes my white head on my nose. 'll definitely buy it again.

If you were like my nose at the end of the day, you would love it. I have a combination skin with the oily area of nose, under the lips, and between the eyebrow. A couple drops of the product goes on nicely to work on the solidified oil to melt away.

avis.titre: a happy addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: The texture is silky and lightweight, easily spreads over dry skin without feeling heavy. After massaging and rinsing, my skin feels smooth and clean, not tight or stripped, and my pores looking clearer, especially around my nose and chin, a happy addition to my routine.

Tried this serum out on my boyfriends face cause he has more issues with pores getting clogged and because his face is much oilier than mine! We definitely noticed a different especially in the nose area. After a couple uses his skin looked fresher and less bogged down! Gifted by decortebeauty in exchange for my honest review.

This was an interesting product to try as I struggle with an oily t-zone with occasional blackheads. The instructions say to use on dry skin and then rinse off after a minute or so. After rinsing it off, my face looked smoother and more glowy - a great base for makeup or the rest of your skincare! Gifted by Decorte Beauty

avis.titre: Cleansing oil to take out blackheads
avis.texte: Ive tried similar products like this so Im familiar with how it works. I like to put the oil directly on my ring fingers or nose and rub in a circular motion (make sure skin is dry). The instructions say 1 min, but I find you have to do it for more like 3 minutes. If you look at your fingertips, you will see actual blackheads or whiteheads that have come out and you can even feel it. Then wash it off with water. It does work! Theres a mild perfume scent that I Dont like. I received this product for free to review.

Absolutely! Here are two human-like 50-word reviews for the laminate sample-sized serum: --- **Review 1:** I received a laminate sample of this serum and was instantly impressed! The lightweight texture absorbs quickly, and my pores looked visibly smaller after just a few uses. My skin felt smooth, refreshed, and less oily throughout the day. its gentle yet effective—perfect for my sensitive combination skin. Very excited to try more! --- **Review 2:** Tried the laminate sample and loved how clean and soft my skin felt afterward. The serum is lightweight, non-sticky, and left my pores noticeably tighter. My skin tone looked more even, and redness was reduced. No irritation at all. A great option for anyone looking for visible results without harsh ingredients.

I received a free sample of the AQ Pore Cleanser from Decorte and Skeepers. This is an oily cleanser intended to help lift dirt and oil from pores for a clean complexion. While I only received a small amount of this, it doesnt take much to clean the face. You want to use it on dry skin and with dry hands, massaging it around before rinsing. It left my skin really soft, and it cleans thoroughly without making my skin feel dry or squeaky: it may not feel like a complete cleanse if you are used to aggressive gel cleansers, because it doesnt strip oils from the skin. Id love to try this for a longer period of time to see how my skin responds.

I have large pores on my nose. This product has been helping clear out the blackheads. My pores are still noticeable but there are no blackheads. This is a nice oil base product. Gentle on the skin. the smell is nice and light nothing overbearing. High quality feel.

I used this on dry skin and rubbed it in well and then rinsed it off. I especially focused on my nose since thats where my pores are the most noticeable. I had really high hopes but this product made no difference to my pores. I wouldnt use again.

avis.titre: Not enough product to truly test its potential
avis.texte: Thank you @skeepers for sending over a free sample of the Decorte AQ Pore Cleanser. I was excited to try it but unfortunately, the sachet contained such a small amount of product (0. 02 FL. OZ. ) that it was barely enough to cover my face once. Because of this, I wasnt able to properly assess how the serum performs or notice any visible effects. With skincare, especially something like a pore-refining product, it usually takes a few uses to form a fair opinion. Based on this limited trial, I cant say it did anything for my skin, simply because there wasnt enough to truly experience what the product claims to offer.

The Decorte AQ Pore Blackhead Dissolver feels like a treat—light, silky, and surprisingly effective at softening blackheads without any harshness. It cleared up my usual trouble spots (nose and chin) after a few uses and left my skin feeling smooth and hydrated, not stripped. Complimentary product received for review.

I received a laminate sample of this serum and was instantly impressed! The lightweight texture absorbs quickly, and my pores looked visibly smaller after just a few uses. My skin felt smooth, refreshed, and less oily throughout the day. its gentle yet effective—perfect for my sensitive combination skin. Very excited to try more!

Wow what a noticeable difference I feel like I just got a facial. I did mine after the steam room for extra open pores after I dried my face down as recommended. I definitely get the hype now. My pores are so small and it was fine on my sensitive skin.

After using this one time I didnt see any results. I was only able to use it once. This didnt have an offending odor. I just squeezed it out of the packet and then rubbed it in circles. It was simple to use. I received this complimentary.

Loving this cleansing serum. It effectively breaks down makeup and dirt off my face. I have cleaner and smoother skin after use and would recommend for anyone looking go properly dissolve makeup and dirt.

Received a sample of this in exchange for my review. I am thoroughly impressed with this cleanser, it is oil based and I typically avoid them but this is a light oil which isnt heavy on the skin. Noticed a difference in the sebaceous filaments on my nose area. With continued use I can definitely see this making a significant difference in my areas of concern. I really enjoyed the scent of this cleanser as well. A luxurious experience.

The Decorte Q Pore Cleanser sample delivers a gentle yet deeply effective exfoliating experience, targeting congestion and blackheads with its innovative formula. Touted as a 'quantum-computer—'designed' serum cleanser, it dissolves sebum and keratin plugs effortlessly, leaving skin remarkably smooth and refined. Users praise its lightweight texture and elegant floral—'musk scent, noting that pores appear less visible and skin gains a radiant, clear look without any stripping or tightness. Reviews of sister cleansing products from Decorte echo this sentiment, calling them soft, light, and among the best cleansers theyve ever tried. Overall, even as a sample or laminate, it feels like a premium at-home facial—refining pores, imparting glow, and leaving skin supple and balanced.

This stuff works! I have lots of blackheads and it gets rid of them all. I can see myself using this consistently in my routine. It works great at clearing up my acne prone skin. Gifted by decortebeauty

I received a complimentary sample from Decorte I tried a tiny sample pack of this, so I could only use it once. It felt nice on the skin ,texture like oil and gentle, it rinsed off easily without leaving any dryness. But since it was just a one-time use, I am not fully convinced if it actually works. I still have a few blackheads on my cheeks, so I didnt notice a visible difference right away. Also, I am a bit confused about what this product is supposed to do ,is it just for blackheads, or is it meant to do more? I wish the brand was clearer about its exact purpose.

I am delighted with the soft exfoliating facial soap! This cleanser has been a real change to my skin care routine and I cannot help but recommend it. From the first application, I noticed a difference in the texture of my skin; it feels softer and more renewed

I would love to say that I have notice dramatic result right away, however I did not see anything special. My beakheads did not dissolve instantly, though overall looked a bit better. I do not think that I will use it more.

AQ Pore Cleanser (Sample/Laminate) gifted by Decorte. The sample packet arrived well packed. Presentation as expected. Product has a watery oil consistency. Noticed a light, yet not overwhelming scent to the product. Tested on hand. Product maintained original consistency. Skin felt tight and dry after rinsing.

The sample has arrived and I have a small experience with it. Its just that I have to see little more so it was ok for me. I have to try some more days but so far it looks good on my skin the texture is nice.

Ive noticed my pores look smaller and less congested, and my skin feels softer and more balanced overall. It removes all the dirt, oil, and even leftover makeup really well. Plus, it has a subtle, fresh scent that makes it feel like a little spa moment every time I use it.

This is a new brand and type of product to try, and I was happy after trying. It cleaned my skin well with no irritation to the skin. Although it says dissolving, i did not think it was harsh. I would have to keep using to gauge true results.

Decorte AQ Pore Blackhead Dissolver/Deep Pore Cleanser worked well for me. After one use, I did notice fewer blackheads on my nose area. My skin showed no irritation or reaction after using the product.

This cleanser has a really nice texture, rich and creamy without being too heavy, and it spreads easily on the skin. I enjoyed how soft and smooth my skin felt right after rinsing it off, and it didnt leave any tight or dry feeling, which I always appreciate. The scent is on the stronger side though, a little more perfumed than I personally prefer for a skincare product. It does an okay job at clearing out surface oil and some buildup around the nose, but I didnt notice a big difference in my pores overall. its not a bad product at all, but I was expecting a bit more from the results. its one of those things that feels nice to use, but Im still on the fence about whether its something Id reach for consistently.

Well this is my honest review, the product is very expensive so I expected a miracle not less. But it is just an oily cleanser, it does not clean my skin too deep I can still see some blackheads. The skin is moisturized after this product , I was gifted by this brand

Complimentary from decortebeauty. i actually have used this products on two separate occasions now. i love it!! i struggling with bad blackheads especially on my nose and this really does the trick! i love it.

I have enlarged pores and I always look for the solution to make them less visible. This cleanser is phenomenal! It really minimize the pores. I used it in the morning and in the evening. Pores look smaller and the skin looks so much healthier, also skin feels very smooth and fresh

The Decorte AG Pore Cleanser is a gentle yet effective cleanser that has worked wonders for my skin. It thoroughly cleans my pores without stripping my skin of its natural oils. Ive noticed a significant reduction in pore appearance and my skin feels smoother. The formula is non-irritating, making it perfect for sensitive skin. Gifted by Decorte

Decorte AQ Pore Cleanser is generally formulated to help deep cleanse pores, remove impurities, and promote a smoother, clearer complexion. It includes effective ingredients such as exfoliants, hydrating agents, and soothing components to help maintain the skins balance while addressing issues like clogged pores and dullness.

My skin feels so smooth and clean after single use. My pores have significantly improved and they are less clogged even after single application. My makeup application went smooth as well overall I really enjoyed this product and definitely recommend it.

Ive got it Complimentary from decortebeauty and it was the first time Ive ever tried anything from this brand. I like how fast and easy it dissolves black heads leaving my skin clean, bright and soft!

I applied this on my dry skin and rubbed in circular motions on my face. I was shocked had deep cleaning this was for my pores. My pores were dark and very visible and this product really dissolved that deep dirt. My skin looks so much brighter and smooth.

Deep cleaning for your pores! This Cleanser leaves you feeling bright and rejuvenated, the added oil control is a bonus. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a fresh and smooth feeling face. This was gifted from Decorte.

This is a cleanser to clean your pores and make them look smaller. The cleanser needs to be used on dry skin and massaged into your face for a minimum of a minute to work. It is great for getting blackheads out of my t-zone. I do find that I need to double cleanse, since just using water afterwards still makes my skin feel weird. It does work in making my pores appear smaller though and doesnt cause my sensitive skin to have any bad reaction.

Gifted by decortebeauty I tried this sample of DECORTÉ AQ for the pores and the truth is that I was quite surprised. It has a serum-oil type texture that feels super light, but when you massage it you can see how it starts to work. After rinsing, I felt the skin softer and cleaner, especially in the nose area. It didnt remove all the black dots from one, but it did help soften them and make them look less marked. To be just a sample of 0. 8 mL, it performs well for one application. If it continues to work like this with continuous use, I would encourage myself to buy the large size. In addition, it smells good and feels luxurious.

avis.titre: Pores Visibly Cleared After Just One Use!
avis.texte: Gifted by decortebeauty, I received a sample of the Decorte AQ Pore Blackhead Dissolver and Im honestly impressed! The lightweight texture melted into my skin and felt so refreshing. After rinsing, my skin looked smoother and clearer — pores appeared visibly tighter and cleaner. No irritation at all, even on my sensitive skin. I would definitely consider buying the full size!

I received this product for free for my honest review. This did a good job at exfoliating my skin before cleansing. The instructions say to rub into your dry skin before cleansing. I Dont know that this product is more effective than others on the market though.

I received the Decorte AQ Pore Cleanser and Blackhead Dissolver as a gift, and Ive genuinely enjoyed using them as part of my skincare routine. The cleanser works best on dry skin, and I appreciated the smooth, lightweight texture that spread easily with the dropper. I followed the instructions by massaging it in circular motions for about a minute before rinsing, and my skin felt refreshed without feeling stripped. The Blackhead Dissolver also impressed me—it gently loosened clogged pores around my nose after consistent use, making my skin feel cleaner and smoother. I noticed visible improvement in texture without any irritation. Both products felt luxurious and effective, and Ill definitely keep using them for a deeper cleanse a few times a week.

This sample I got it complimentary from Decorte. This sample is a very meaningful try for me. This essence is very moisturizing and can effectively penetrate my skin. It is very watery and spreads well. Moreover, the pores around the tip of my nose have obviously shrunk. I really feel that my nose and the area around my nostrils are much cleaner. Suddenly, my skin seems to be breathing! I highly recommend it.
